$comment: DOCUMENTATION ONLY - see the note in agent-work-contract.schema.json. This is Step 3's db-work-completion record with contract fields added. There is deliberately NOT a second completion schema: Steps 3 and 4 originally defined two that disagreed about whether `pr` was required, which an owner-ruling outcome cannot satisfy.
title: Agent completion report

fields.contract_ref: the refs/db-contracts/... ref this work was authorised by
fields.contract_sha256: sha256 of the canonicalized contract. Must match the published ref, or the contract was changed after the fact
fields.head_sha: the commit the work ended at
fields.files_changed: must be a subset of the contract's allowed_paths + file_writes
fields.db_reads: must not exceed the contract's db_reads + db_writes
fields.db_writes: must not exceed the contract's db_writes
fields.checks: array of { command, exit_code, evidence }. Evidence is required: a claim of success is not evidence
fields.assumptions_resolved: which of the contract's assumptions turned out to hold
fields.stop_conditions_hit: which stop conditions fired. A report that hit one CANNOT also claim outcome=merged
